newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Moore Hong Leong plans more China plants.
newsitem.headline: Moore Hong Leong plans more China plants.

text.p: Singapore private financial group Hong Leong Corp said on Monday its 50-50 joint venture with Canada's Moore Corp had officially opened a labels manufacturing plant in Guangzhou, China.
The company said in a statement the joint venture, Moore Hong Leong, planned to open several other plants in China in the next two or three years.

"Areas under consideration are Beijing, Wuhan, Shanghai and Tianjin. Each plant will require an initial investment of US$3.0 million, with a further US$2-3 million each by the sixth year of operation," it said.
"The joint venture aims to achieve an annual turnover of US$150 million by the year 2000," it added.
